title: Weighted gene co-expression network analysis identifies functional modules related to bovine respiratory disease.
authors: Ghahramani, Nooshin; Hashemi, Ali; Panahi, Bahman
one_liner_zh: 该文用WGCNA和机器学习分析牛呼吸道疾病转录组，识别关键转录因子（如GABPA、TCF4）和CFB基因，但仅基于共表达网络推断TF-DNA调控关系，无三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，属于边缘相关。
abstract: Bovine respiratory disease (BRD) is a multifactorial disease of dairy and beef cattle that involves complex interactions with the host immune system. In the current study, a comprehensive meta-analysis was performed using a P-value combination approach. In the next step, the identified meta-genes were subjected to systems biology analysis using the weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) method. Subsequently, the most functionally important modules and genes were validated using machine learning algorithms. Finally, the critical regulatory network associated with BRD was constructed. A total of 1,908 common meta-genes were identified through the combined analysis of differentially expressed genes (DEGs) using the Fisher and Invorm approaches. Co-expression network analysis confirmed six functional modules, among which the connectivity patterns of the blue, brown, green, and yellow modules were significantly altered in BRD-affected cattle compared with healthy controls. Functional enrichment analysis of the significant modules revealed that the 'Salmonella infection,' 'NOD-like receptor signaling pathway,' 'Necroptosis,' 'Toll-like receptor signaling pathway,' 'TNF signaling pathway,' 'IL-17 signaling pathway,' 'Apoptosis,' and 'Influenza A' pathways were the most significantly associated with BRD. The constructed regulatory network identified GABPA, TCF4, ELK1, NR2C2, and ARNT as key transcription factors (TFs), each playing a central role in regulating immune and inflammatory pathways implicated in BRD. Finally, the constructed model revealed that differential expression of the CFB gene is significantly associated with susceptibility to BRD. In cattle, CFB expression correlates with clinical signs of respiratory disease, supporting its potential as a biomarker. Moreover, the involvement of CFB in modulating pro-inflammatory cytokines (e.g., TNF) and its integration with other immune-related pathways (e.g., NF-kappaB signaling) further highlight its relevance as a biomarker. Overall, this integrative approach enhances our understanding of the molecular mechanisms underlying BRD and provides a foundation for developing diagnostic, therapeutic, and genetic selection strategies to improve cattle health and disease resistance.
abstract_zh: 牛呼吸道疾病（BRD）是一种影响奶牛和肉牛的多因素疾病，涉及与宿主免疫系统的复杂相互作用。在本研究中，采用P值合并方法进行了全面的荟萃分析。下一步，利用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）方法对识别出的meta基因进行系统生物学分析。随后，使用机器学习算法验证功能上最重要的模块和基因。最后，构建了与BRD相关的关键调控网络。通过结合Fisher和Invorm方法对差异表达基因（DEGs）进行综合分析，共识别出1,908个共同的meta基因。共表达网络分析确认了六个功能模块，其中蓝色、棕色、绿色和黄色模块的连通性模式在受BRD影响的牛与健康对照组相比显著改变。对显著模块的功能富集分析揭示，‘沙门氏菌感染’、‘NOD样受体信号通路’、‘坏死性凋亡’、‘Toll样受体信号通路’、‘TNF信号通路’、‘IL-17信号通路’、‘细胞凋亡’和‘甲型流感’通路与BRD最显著相关。构建的调控网络识别出GABPA、TCF4、ELK1、NR2C2和ARNT为关键转录因子（TFs），每个都在调控与BRD相关的免疫和炎症通路中发挥核心作用。最后，构建的模型揭示CFB基因的差异表达与BRD易感性显著相关。在牛中，CFB表达与呼吸道疾病的临床症状相关，支持其作为生物标志物的潜力。此外，CFB在调节促炎细胞因子（如TNF）中的参与及其与其他免疫相关通路（如NF-kappaB信号）的整合进一步突显了其作为生物标志物的相关性。总体而言，这种整合方法增强了我们对BRD潜在分子机制的理解，并为制定诊断、治疗和遗传选择策略以改善牛健康和疾病抵抗力奠定了基础。
